questions.text: Draw the flowchart of Booth's multiplication algorithm and multiply $(-7) \times (-10)$ using Booth's algorithm.
Write down the code to evaluate the arithmetic statement $Y = (A - B / C) \times [D + (E \times G)]$ using zero-address, one-address, two-address, and three-address instructions.
Define addressing modes. Explain the different types of addressing modes with suitable examples and compare each of them.
Differentiate between hardwired control unit and microprogrammed control unit. Draw and explain the block diagram of microprogrammed control organization and address sequencing.
How pipeline processing is done in an instruction pipeline? Explain four-segment instruction pipeline with timing diagram. What are the major pipeline hazards and how are they resolved?
Describe the procedure for floating-point addition and subtraction with the help of a detailed flowchart.
Differentiate between restoring division and non-restoring division algorithms. Perform the division of $10 / 3$ using restoring division algorithm.
Explain various mapping methods used in cache memory organization (Direct mapping, Associative mapping, and Set-associative mapping) and compare each with suitable diagrams.
Explain Least Recently Used (LRU) replacement algorithm in case of hit and miss. Suppose main memory has 64 blocks and cache has 16 lines; determine the size of tag, line, and word fields.
Compare Programmed I/O, Interrupt-driven I/O, and Direct Memory Access (DMA). How does a DMA controller transfer data between high-speed peripheral and memory?
Differentiate between isolated I/O and memory-mapped I/O. Explain with block diagram and control signal requirements.
Why is an Input-Output Processor (IOP) needed in an input-output organization? Explain how CPU and IOP communicate with each other.
Differentiate between tightly coupled multiprocessor and loosely coupled multiprocessor systems with neat block diagrams.
Compare and contrast the interconnection structures used in multiprocessor systems: Time-shared common bus, Multiport memory, Crossbar switch, and Hypercube network.
Explain inter-processor synchronization with suitable example. What is mutual exclusion with a semaphore and how is it implemented?
Design a 2-bit ALU that can perform subtraction, AND, OR, and XOR operations with function table and logic diagram.
